Specifically, we finetuned two RoBERTa-based classifiers for the evaluations of sentiment and topic. The tense accuracy was evaluated by the same tool adopted in the training set, and we used word-level Copy Success Rate (CSR) to evaluate the lexical constraint. In addition, we used the perplexity (PPL) given by GPT-2 medium and averaged distinctness to evaluate the fluency and diversity of the generated text, respectively.
